ITEM 1 | Square white plate, roughly 26 cm across, used as the reference; the food sits on its left-center and right side. Not a food item, so no weight. | 0
ITEM 2 | Pale tan-beige block with a rough, bumpy, crumbly surface, topped with white flaky granular crumbs and a light cream-colored coating; about 8 cm by 5 cm footprint covering roughly 6% of the plate, around 2.5 cm thick, with browned edges at the base suggesting baking or pan-searing. | 110
ITEM 3 | Loose, ruffled heap of dark green leafy strands with a slightly glossy, creamy-coated sheen, scattered with small white shreds and pale flakes; spread across roughly 12 cm by 11 cm (about 15% of the plate), piled about 2 cm high, with a few darker bits and a thin whitish film, sitting on the right side of the plate. | 85
ITEM 4 | Two halved cylinders of yellow corn cob, each about 4.5 cm across and 3 cm thick, with pale cream kernel centers and a bright yellow rim of kernels, placed side by side at the bottom center; dry-looking surface with slight sheen. | 90
ITEM 5 | Thin pale off-white shaved flakes and small pieces, one larger translucent-white chip about 2.5 cm across sitting on top of the greens, plus a few smaller crumbs scattered among the leaves, all lying flat and slightly curled, likely a dry hard cheese garnish. | 10
